summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by YPF Sociedad Anónima, a foreign private issuer, reporting a routine repurchase of its own Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between May 18-22, 2026. The repurchase amounted to Ps. 15,794,768,333.96 (US$11,331,347 par value) at an average price of 99.86% of nominal value, and the notes will be held in portfolio. The notes mature in July 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an ordinary liability management transaction, not a capital-return event or tender offer triggering special-situation status. What to watch: further liability management steps are possible given the maturity.
